title: PhD Positions in Gravity at the Extreme
institution: Max Planck Institute for Gravitational Physics (Albert Einstein Institute), IMPRS Gravity at the Extreme
about: The Albert Einstein Institute in Potsdam, Germany is recruiting several PhD students for its IMPRS 'Gravity at the Extreme' (3-4 years, in English), covering relativity, gravitational-wave data analysis and multi-messenger astrophysics. Apply online by 4 January 2027; reference letters by 11 January.
requirements: Master's degree by the start of the PhD programme
Cover letter, CV, transcripts, research-interests statement (up to three pages), three referees

upskill.name: AI for Research & Information Synthesis
